# Booltools Security Checker

> Open-source security validation checker for software applications

## Overview

Booltools Security Checker audits repositories and cloud architectures against thousands of known vulnerabilities from NVD, CWE, MITRE ATT&CK, CAPEC, Nuclei, CISA KEV, EPSS, Exploit-DB, GitHub Advisory, and OSV.dev.

## Features

- Web UI for interactive audits
- REST API for automation
- MCP server for AI agents
- Real-time SSE progress streaming
- CSV and Markdown export
- Docker deployment
